credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Winsor & Newton box with three (3) tubes of "Oil Colour Griffin Permanent White paint." Each tube is encased a cardboard sleeve imprinted with the logo: Winsor & Newton, Ltd. in black ink. A die cut window shows the name of the oil paint. The box has a yellow, gold, and blue label depicting the Winsor & Newton factory.
title: Winsor & Newton Box of Oil Paint
